notes: src/.env's Demo section previously used invalid space-containing keys ('MT5 Login=', 'MT5 Password=', 'MT5 Server=') that no environment loader could parse; renamed in place to MT5_LOGIN/MT5_PASSWORD/MT5_SERVER with user confirmation, values never read or printed by this process beyond what was necessary to perform the rename edit.

A pre-existing, now-superseded duplicate empty MT5_LOGIN/MT5_PASSWORD/MT5_SERVER block (documented as unused MetaAPI reference) was renamed to MT5_LEGACY_METAAPI_LOGIN/PASSWORD/SERVER to remove a last-wins key collision that would otherwise have silently overridden the real Demo credentials with empty values.

The .env Live section (VANTAGE-LIVE, VANTAGE-LIVE-PASSWORD, VANTAGE-SERVER, 'Acc Type=Standard STP') was left untouched per explicit user instruction; 'Acc Type=Standard STP' still has an invalid space-containing key and is silently skipped by python-dotenv (harmless, does not block loading of other variables) -- not remediated, out of scope.
